A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Physics Context Builders research. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including v3's added Appendix D.

before.justification: v2 reports original fine-tuning, PCB augmentation, Sim2Real, routing, and ablation results in Sections 3–4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds InternVL3-8B evaluations with and without PCB augmentation in Appendix D.2.

M1.justification: Both versions use LoRA-fine-tuned PaliGemma-3B to generate physical descriptions for foundation models, with the same HN/SP formats and optional triage-agent routing. The InternVL experiment applies the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both use CLEVRER and simulated/real Falling Tower with the same question categories and environments. Appendix D adds model comparisons within this retained coverage, without introducing datasets or task scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 11 adds reported CLEVRER comparisons with VRDP, DCL, and CRCG; Aloe was already compared numerically in v2 Section 3.2. Table 12 adds zero-shot InternVL3-8B as the comparator for its PCB-augmented version.

E3.justification: Appendix D.2 introduces an 8B InternVL3 evaluation configuration with zero-shot and HN-PCB conditions. Previously reported splits, metrics, frame sampling, and training budgets remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish reruns of existing experiments.

E4.justification: The QA-type, data-quantity, question-framing, training-epoch, and vision-freezing ablations retain their settings and evidence. HN/SP comparisons and Sim2Real analyses are also retained. Appendix D adds benchmark comparisons without a distinct new robustness or ablation analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added tables continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 retain their numerical values. Appendix D adds specialized CLEVRER baseline scores and InternVL3 results; Table 12 reports simulated tower-stability accuracy of 46.42 for zero-shot InternVL3-8B and 83.07 with PCB. These are additional results, not improvements over a v2 InternVL evaluation.

T1.justification: Neither version introduces formal theorems, proofs, or mathematical derivations. The descriptions of training objectives and evaluation definitions remain equivalent.

C1.justification: The three central contributions remain modular context builders, separation of perception from reasoning, and simulation-trained transfer without inference-time simulation. The abstract retains the reported maximum average accuracy improvement of 13.8% and the Sim2Real claim.

C2.justification: Appendix D.1 explicitly qualifies that fine-tuned PaliGemma does not outperform every specialized benchmark and interprets its comparable performance as supporting generalist models. Existing mechanism explanations and limitations concerning reasoning, physical coverage, and annotations remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: Table 7 clarifies the Falling Tower trainable-parameter entries as 1.24%, supplying percent signs omitted in v2. Table 12 specifies the added InternVL3.0 model's 8B size. Existing LoRA settings, hardware, compute times, and dataset access links are retained.

R1.justification: Appendix D.1 modestly expands the generalist-versus-specialized positioning beyond the earlier Aloe comparison. The cited-work set and Related Work arguments otherwise remain the same; publication and citation-format updates do not introduce new research lines.

P1.justification: v3 shortens the abstract, copyedits prose, numbers Related Work subsections, presents datasets as bullets, and adds acknowledgements and Appendix D. The main argument and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch from one to two columns, with extensive display resizing and relocation. v2 Figure 4 becomes inline CLEVRER HN/SP example boxes, omitting its Falling Tower panel, while related description content remains elsewhere. v3 also adds Tables 11–12.

improvement.justification: Appendix D adds useful evidence for PCB augmentation on another VLM and broadens the comparison with specialized CLEVRER methods while explicitly qualifying relative performance. This modestly strengthens empirical support and positioning. Sparse experimental detail and unchanged uncertainty reporting limit the gains; the extensive reformatting alone does not establish scientific improvement.
